cohort: 1129 pregnant women with abnormal 50 g GCT results who delivered between 2018 and 2020 in three secondary care hospitals in Thailand
finding: Pregnant women with abnormal 50 g GCT, even without a GDM diagnosis, experienced higher rates of undesirable outcomes, such as cesarean section and birth asphyxia, highlighting the need for close monitoring throughout pregnancy and postpartum.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were statistically higher in the group with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) compared to groups with abnormal glucose challenge test results but without GDM.
